changelog: First-class admin panel: a premium branded sidebar with grouped sections (Main, Customers & Catalog, Money & Reports, Communication, Administration, System), clean active states, a polished top bar with search and avatar, and a pinned New Order button. Fully responsive — the sidebar is fixed on desktop and slides in on mobile.
The whole admin now follows your brand colour — buttons, links, badges and highlights all use it consistently.

Design proof links (and OTPs, order confirmations, payment receipts, status updates) now send to the customer immediately, even during quiet hours. Quiet hours now apply only to non-urgent bulk reminders.
